content: Nuwadobi
Howahowana Besinana i'abiye atepatugita, bo yana velauwena ta'ai'aipate? Howahowana Alu'aluwa Ve'ahihi ive'au'augeluwegita, yo ainaena tavelau namwanamwaegita yo ta'atemuyamuyauyoigita?
Ebe dova, amvenuwatoyawa na amvelau namwanamwaegomiu, alu'aluwamiyena yo atemiyena amve'ehebo ta ebe yami velau namwanamwana teina vehabana yayaliyaya moiha.
Havena am'ai'aiduma yo amnuwahaehae, na hesi amnuwadobi, yo ami geluwo yehadi am'abihinidi.
Havena ambom yami paihowa vehabana amnuwanuwatuwu na hesi ami geluwo yadi miya namwanamwa vehabana amnuwanuwatuwu.
Howahowana ebe yami nuwatuwuwo Yeisu Besinana yana nuwatuwu dova.
Iya Yaubada, na hesi nigele nuwanuwana ta yana vetauloina i'abi avivini,
aenaena Yaubada yana wasawasa ilaugabaei, na hilabahi bale'uwai, ta ivetaupaihowa ana oleya tomowa ita dova.
Hinage yana nuwadobi ainaena, ibom italamyowei ta imwalowoi aiwa lagalagana ainai.
Teina vehabana Yaubada Yeisu i'abihini na yehanane i'abihiniuyoi yeha maudoidi ewadiyai,
eeta yehanane taumiya galewa yo taumiya bale'u na taumiya bwebweso hinage, maudoida tapwagogo ainai,
yo ta'awa moiha ebeha Yeisu Besinana ibom yada Bada, neta Tamada Yaubada tano'owei.
Masele taumiya bale'u vehabadi

Augeluwo, mwalona am'awa abi moiha na teina ta'i alimiyena yamiya amwaha daodao'o, na besiwa howola am'awa'awa abi ili'ilimani, ta mayami meheuhi na mayami atehawawali ampaipaihowa ta ebe livahi namwanamwana ainai ammiya ili'ilimani.
Yaubada iya atemiyai ipaipaihowa, ta ibom yana nuwatuwuwena amnuwanuwatuwu na ampaipaihowa.
Yami paihowa aidiyai amtalam ampaihowa, na havena amta'wata'wata yo nuwana am'ulu'ulumiyai,
ta ainaena omiu Yaubada natunao namwanamwamiu yo masemaselemiu, eeta nigele teya yami yababa, na hesi taumiya bale'u yadi masele omiu, wuwuna hibom mumugadi guguyouna yo yababana.
Augeluwo, wasa namwanamwana am'abi avivini ta ainaena yawahi vateyai amlobai, na haugana Besinana ilau gwaipilema yayaliyaya, wuwuna nigele nuwagu yagu paihowao alimiyai yagabaedi.
Ebe agu alehao hi'oiye mwalowoigau, neta dova hipwaoliyegau yami yemidi vehabana, ta mata omiu baidaguwao tayaliyaya.
Ta ebe howahowana na omiu baidaguwo tayaliyaya toyawa.
Yanuwatuwuhae ebeha yada Bada Yeisu yana haguwena mata hauga iu'iuna ainai Timoti yavetamalaenawa ta wasamiu ivaiyama, eeta yabenalei na ebe yayaliyaya.
Timoti ibom agu tauhagune, na nigele teya yaiya iyamiyamiya ta ebe vehabamiu inuwatuwu ili'ilimani.
Na agu tau'abihaguwo bagibagilidi hibom vehabadi hinuwanuwatuwu, na nigele Yeisu Besinana yana paihowa vehabana hiyanuwanuwatuwu.
Timoti amhanapuiya'o neta towaho namwanamwana, ta iya dova natugu baidagu wasa namwanamwana vehabana a'ai'aipate.
Eeta haugana ebe agu loina yabenalei, nuwanuwagu na Timoti yavetamalenawa alimiyai.
Na yayemidi mata yada Bada yana hagu yalobai ta hauga iu'iuna ta'i na yau hinage yalaowa alimiyai.

Teina hauga nuwanuwagu Epapilodaito yavetamalenawa ilau gwaipilewa alimiyai, ibom tahigu baidagu apaipaihowa, bada dova a'ale'aleha Yeisu Besinana vehabana. Epapilodaito mugai agu hagu alimiyena ivaiyama'o,
na teina ta'i iya nuwanuwana omiu, ta haugana yana lovala wasana ilaowa ta ambenalena'o, inuwavitai moiha wuwuna omiu am'ate'atehawawali yana lovala vehabana.
Bada ilovala'o mwala'ina, na hesi Yaubada i'atemuyamuyaei, yo hinage yau i'atemuyamuyaegau wuwuna mata dova ta Epapilodaito imwalowoi na ainaena yanuwavitai moiha.
Ainaena nuwanuwagu mwala'ina yavetamalenawa na am'itauyoi mayana namwanamwa ta ebe amyaliyaya, eeta yagu nuwayababa i'ovi.
Haugana imahalavawa yada Bada yehanaena amyogaei yami vadai mayami yaliyaya. Yo hinage tupwadi yada Bada yana taupaihowao, ebe hilaowa alimiyai dova amve'ahihiyedi.
Moiha Epapilodaito muhamuhana na Besinana yana paihowa ainaena imwalowoi, wuwuna omiu nigele howahowamiu yo amhaguigau, eeta iya italam ta ihahaguigaune neta vehabana ilolovalane.
